neighbours.label: The digits of a statistic given as a percentage or risk multiple in poll, health and survey reports (53% said, 13 times the risk), not numbers that are years, addresses or plain counts.
fire: In the latest survey, 61% said they would vote for the measure.
According to the poll, 47% of voters approve of the governor.
Smokers had 15 times the risk of lung cancer compared with non-smokers.
The study found that 72% of patients improved within a month.
A new poll shows 58% oppose the plan and 36% support it.
Children in the program were 3 times as likely to finish school.
In the survey, 64% of nurses said they planned to leave the job.
Asked about the new tax, 55% of respondents said it was unfair.
quiet: In the latest season, the team won its first match in 1961.
According to the map, the station is at 47 King Street.
Smokers had to stand outside in the rain near gate 15.
The study was published in 1972 in a medical journal.
A new poll will be held on 15 March in all districts.
Children in the program read 3 books each term.
In the survey, nurses described their work in their own words.
Asked about the new tax, the minister said nothing at all.
